data.title: Former Kosovo president convicted of war crimes
data.description: PRISTINA - Former Kosovo president Hashim Thaci, sentenced to 25 years in prison on Wednesday for war crimes, has long been seen within the Balkan country as a guerilla hero and symbol of its bloody independence struggle.

data.title: German state premier aims to halt far-right surge
data.description: ROSTOCK, Germany - Germany’s anti-immigration AfD party is eyeing another election triumph on Sunday in a northeastern coastal state where the popular premier is campaigning on a promise to hold back a rising far-right tide.

data.title: Turkish courts jails LGBTQ activists as crackdown widens
data.description: ISTANBUL - Turkish courts have jailed more LGBTQ activists and supporters, raising to 62 the number remanded in custody following a weekend crackdown, a legal rights group said on Wednesday.

data.title: True Corporation and SWU elevate EdTech with a True AI Hub-powered online learning platform
data.description: True Corporation has partnered with Srinakharinwirot University (SWU) to reshape Thailand’s learning ecosystem with EdTech, educational technology that makes a difference through new learning models.

data.title: EU considers ‘associate member’ status for Canada
data.description: STRASBOURG, France - EU chief Ursula von der Leyen raised the prospect Wednesday of Canada becoming the 27-nation bloc’s first “associate member’, as she pitched closer cooperation on technology, defence and energy to Canadian leader Mark Carney.

data.title: Amnesty documents ‘crimes against humanity’ by Iran in 2022
data.description: PARIS - Iranian authorities committed crimes against humanity in the crackdown on 2022 protests that left hundreds dead, Amnesty International said Wednesday, adding Tehran’s suppression of new demonstrations this year bore the “same hallmarks” but on an even wider scale.

data.title: Scammers ‘moving through Thailand to new base in Malaysia’
data.description: Police say they have detected a network set up to smuggle scammers through Thailand to Malaysia, as they attempt to flee crackdowns elsewhere in Southeast Asia.

data.title: Continuous heavy rain triggers flood warnings in North
data.description: Heavy to very heavy rain is expected across Thailand between Thursday and Sunday, with warnings of flash floods, river overflows and landslides, particularly in the North, the Meteorological Department said on Wednesday.

data.title: Tourism stimulus likely to be postponed until April
data.description: The government’s planned “Thai Tiew Thai Plus” domestic tourism stimulus scheme is likely to be postponed until April next year, amid concerns that staging a promotion during the high season starting in October would have limited economic benefits.

data.title: Philippines’ ex-leader Duterte makes first appearance at ICC
data.description: MANILA — Former Philippines president Rodrigo Duterte appeared in person at the International Criminal Court (ICC) for the first time Wednesday, as he faces charges over his "war on drugs" that killed thousands.

data.title: Ex-minister Vorapak named in US sanctions push
data.description: Former deputy finance minister Vorapak Tanyawong is among 26 people and two companies targeted by US lawmakers for sanctions against figures linked to Southeast Asian financial scam gangs.

data.title: Revealed! The Pokémon Center BANGKOK logo!
data.description: Pokémon Center BANGKOK is set to open in December 2026, located on the 6th floor of centralwOrld. The store offers a special space where visitors can immerse themselves in the world of Pokémon while shopping for official Pokémon merchandise.

data.title: The ultimate pencil case for serious artists
data.description: Rimowa is putting a luxury spin on the artist’s toolkit with its latest collaboration with German stationery house Faber-Castell, transforming its signature aluminium luggage design into a limited-edition case for drawing supplies.

data.title: China opens major canal linking landlocked regions to sea
data.description: BEIJING - China opened a major canal on Wednesday that will provide landlocked areas with direct access to the sea, state media said, reducing transport times and costs as the country aims to bolster trade ties with regional neighbours.

data.title: English village votes to 'secede' from UK over asylum centre
data.description: LONDON — An English village of around 350 people announced Wednesday that a vast majority of residents had voted yes in an "independence referendum" to protest plans to house over 1,200 migrants in a nearby facility.

data.title: ONE Championship: Suriyanlek ‘extremely lucky’ as he resumes training after van accident
data.description: Thai fighter Suriyanlek Por Yenying says he feels “extremely lucky” to be back in training after being hit by a van while out running, with the accident giving him fresh motivation to chase a full-time ONE Championship contract.

data.title: Phuket expressway plans taking shape
data.description: The Expressway Authority of Thailand (Exat) is pressing ahead with a 34.6-kilometre expressway network in Phuket to ease traffic congestion and support the province's urban and tourism growth.

data.title: Convicted crime lord plotted prison escape by clinging to a drone
data.description: HONG KONG — A South Korean crime lord convicted of murder in the Philippines reportedly planned to escape prison by strapping himself to a drone – until his own accomplice’s rehearsal footage gave the game away.

data.title: Chinese fugitive tied to B600m nominee business arrested in Samut Sakhon
data.description: A Chinese man who evaded arrest in his home country for over a decade has been arrested in Samut Sakhon on links to nominee companies worth more than 600 million baht and suspicions his son obtained Thai nationality through fraudulent registration.

data.title: Princess Sirivannavari to preside over Thai dress show in Tokyo
data.description: Tokyo’s Thai costume showcase features eight women’s styles, three men’s styles and traditional crafts, with Princess Sirivannavari presiding on September 18.

data.title: ONE Championship: Jonathan Haggerty’s 48-hour Bangkok dash before Akimoto fight – ‘back to work’
data.description: Jonathan Haggerty had barely unpacked from Tokyo when he turned around and headed back to Asia for barely 48 hours – paying for a business-class ticket himself to limit the physical toll of another long-haul journey during fight camp, without sacrificing a day of training.

data.title: Brazilian voters the latest to eye Bukele security model with envy
data.description: RIO DE JANEIRO (BRAZIL) - Fed up with witnessing muggings in Rio de Janeiro's Copacabana neighbourhood, William Correia formed a volunteer group to patrol the streets and report robberies on social media.

data.title: New releases for your streaming pleasure: Sept 16-22
data.description: Looking for a title to binge-watch this weekend? Here's our pick!

data.title: Haze from Indonesia's fires reaches southern Thailand
data.description: Smog from Indonesia's wildfires has reached Thailand's southern province of Songkhla, with major populated areas reporting PM2.5 levels at unhealthy concentrations mostly in the morning and evening.

data.title: Van smashed in police chase found with 464kg of ‘ice’
data.description: PRACHUAP KHIRI KHAN: Highway police arrested the driver of a van that smashed into a residential fence in Muang district after 464 kilogrammes of crystal methamphetamine were found in the vehicle .
